about: Reference cases for the model. Each case: what the user says, what the agent must do, what must NOT happen. Grade by hand or with a judge model.

must: all missing questions in ONE message
after delivery: one-line reminder for skipped items
must_not: start rendering with an empty layout without telling the user

cases.input: Ещё один такой же про cadlookup.com
must: 'Беру настройки как в прошлый раз: ... Менять?'
skip the scene and say so plainly
must_not: stealth plugins, captcha solving, user-agent tricks

cases.input: (QA FAILED: centre does not change for 1.8s)
must: fix the plan (actions, speed, shorter say) and re-render
must_not: deliver the failed video as done
em dash or en dash anywhere

cases.input: Make it in English for TikTok and Shorts
must: voice, captions, titles, description, cover in English
safe zone = intersection of tiktok and youtube_shorts
give cover/prompt.md and ask for an image
must_not: pretend an image model was used
let a model draw Cyrillic text

cases.input: Эдит из Big Buck Bunny под этот трек <url>
(yt-dlp: Sign in to confirm you're not a bot)
must: offer cookies file (SHORTS_YTDLP_COOKIES) or a local file
clips with transcript (faster-whisper) or say that captions are missing

cases.input: Сделай неоновое свечение на тексте, как у всех
must: explain it is banned by the style rules (AI-slop) and offer a flat accent or outline
if the user insists: note it in prefs.rejected or as a per-video exception and warn QA will fail

cases.input: Вот цифры через сутки: 12000 показов, 40% viewed, 55% досмотр, 3 подписки
must: propose ONE experiment for 3 videos, write memory/experiments.md
brand preset mono for this plan only
must_not: overwrite the saved brand without asking
